mapper.sql: relocation_id, personal_workspace_id, app_workspace_version_id, user_id, runtime_workspace_id, source_linux_server_id, target_linux_server_id, branch, source_repo_root_path, source_workspace_root_path, status, attempt_count, lease_owner, lease_until, snapshot_sha256, archive_size_bytes, trace_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select pw.personal_workspace_id, pw.app_workspace_version_id, pw.user_id, pw.runtime_workspace_id, w.linux_server_id as source_linux_server_id, b.linux_server_id as target_linux_server_id from personal_workspaces pw join workspaces w on w.workspace_id = pw.runtime_workspace_id join user_opencode_process_bindings b on b.user_id = pw.user_id and b.agent_id = 'opencode' and b.status = 'ACTIVE' where pw.status = 'ACTIVE' and w.status = 'ACTIVE' and w.linux_server_id = #{sourceLinuxServerId} and w.linux_server_id is not null and b.linux_server_id is not null and w.linux_server_id <> b.linux_server_id and not exists ( select 1 from runs active_run where active_run.workspace_id = pw.runtime_workspace_id and active_run.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') ) order by pw.updated_at, pw.personal_workspace_id limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into personal_workspace_relocations as current_relocation( relocation_id, personal_workspace_id, app_workspace_version_id, user_id, runtime_workspace_id, source_linux_server_id, target_linux_server_id, branch, source_repo_root_path, source_workspace_root_path, status, attempt_count, next_retry_at, trace_id, created_at, updated_at ) select #{relocationId}, pw.personal_workspace_id, pw.app_workspace_version_id, pw.user_id, pw.runtime_workspace_id, w.linux_server_id, b.linux_server_id, pw.branch, pw.repo_root_path, pw.workspace_root_path, 'DISCOVERED', 0, #{now}, #{traceId}, #{now}, #{now} from personal_workspaces pw join workspaces w on w.workspace_id = pw.runtime_workspace_id join user_opencode_process_bindings b on b.user_id = pw.user_id and b.agent_id = 'opencode' and b.status = 'ACTIVE' where pw.personal_workspace_id = #{personalWorkspaceId} and pw.runtime_workspace_id = #{runtimeWorkspaceId} and pw.status = 'ACTIVE' and w.status = 'ACTIVE' and w.linux_server_id = #{sourceLinuxServerId} and b.linux_server_id = #{targetLinuxServerId} and w.linux_server_id <> b.linux_server_id on conflict (personal_workspace_id) do update set relocation_id = excluded.relocation_id, app_workspace_version_id = excluded.app_workspace_version_id, user_id = excluded.user_id, runtime_workspace_id = excluded.runtime_workspace_id, source_linux_server_id = excluded.source_linux_server_id, target_linux_server_id = excluded.target_linux_server_id, branch = excluded.branch, source_repo_root_path = excluded.source_repo_root_path, source_workspace_root_path = excluded.source_workspace_root_path, status = 'DISCOVERED', attempt_count = 0, next_retry_at = excluded.next_retry_at, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, snapshot_sha256 = null, archive_size_bytes = null, safe_error_code = null, safe_error_message = null, target_applied_at = null, completed_at = null, trace_id = excluded.trace_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at where current_relocation.status in ('SUCCEEDED', 'CANCELLED') or ( ( current_relocation.app_workspace_version_id <> excluded.app_workspace_version_id or current_relocation.user_id <> excluded.user_id or current_relocation.runtime_workspace_id <> excluded.runtime_workspace_id or current_relocation.source_linux_server_id <> excluded.source_linux_server_id or current_relocation.target_linux_server_id <> excluded.target_linux_server_id or current_relocation.branch <> excluded.branch or current_relocation.source_repo_root_path <> excluded.source_repo_root_path or current_relocation.source_workspace_root_path <> excluded.source_workspace_root_path ) and ( current_relocation.status in ('DISCOVERED', 'RETRY_WAIT') or ( current_relocation.status in ('EXPORTING', 'TRANSFERRING', 'APPLYING') and (current_relocation.lease_until is null or current_relocation.lease_until <= excluded.updated_at) ) ) )

merge into personal_workspace_relocations target using ( select #{relocationId} relocation_id, pw.personal_workspace_id, pw.app_workspace_version_id, pw.user_id, pw.runtime_workspace_id, w.linux_server_id source_linux_server_id, b.linux_server_id target_linux_server_id, pw.branch, pw.repo_root_path source_repo_root_path, pw.workspace_root_path source_workspace_root_path, #{now} next_retry_at, #{traceId} trace_id, #{now} created_at, #{now} updated_at from personal_workspaces pw join workspaces w on w.workspace_id = pw.runtime_workspace_id join user_opencode_process_bindings b on b.user_id = pw.user_id and b.agent_id = 'opencode' and b.status = 'ACTIVE' where pw.personal_workspace_id = #{personalWorkspaceId} and pw.runtime_workspace_id = #{runtimeWorkspaceId} and pw.status = 'ACTIVE' and w.status = 'ACTIVE' and w.linux_server_id = #{sourceLinuxServerId} and b.linux_server_id = #{targetLinuxServerId} and w.linux_server_id <> b.linux_server_id ) source on target.personal_workspace_id = source.personal_workspace_id when matched and ( target.status in ('SUCCEEDED', 'CANCELLED') or ( ( target.app_workspace_version_id <> source.app_workspace_version_id or target.user_id <> source.user_id or target.runtime_workspace_id <> source.runtime_workspace_id or target.source_linux_server_id <> source.source_linux_server_id or target.target_linux_server_id <> source.target_linux_server_id or target.branch <> source.branch or target.source_repo_root_path <> source.source_repo_root_path or target.source_workspace_root_path <> source.source_workspace_root_path ) and ( target.status in ('DISCOVERED', 'RETRY_WAIT') or ( target.status in ('EXPORTING', 'TRANSFERRING', 'APPLYING') and (target.lease_until is null or target.lease_until <= source.updated_at) ) ) ) ) then update set relocation_id = source.relocation_id, app_workspace_version_id = source.app_workspace_version_id, user_id = source.user_id, runtime_workspace_id = source.runtime_workspace_id, source_linux_server_id = source.source_linux_server_id, target_linux_server_id = source.target_linux_server_id, branch = source.branch, source_repo_root_path = source.source_repo_root_path, source_workspace_root_path = source.source_workspace_root_path, status = 'DISCOVERED', attempt_count = 0, next_retry_at = source.next_retry_at, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, snapshot_sha256 = null, archive_size_bytes = null, safe_error_code = null, safe_error_message = null, target_applied_at = null, completed_at = null, trace_id = source.trace_id, updated_at = source.updated_at when not matched then insert ( relocation_id, personal_workspace_id, app_workspace_version_id, user_id, runtime_workspace_id, source_linux_server_id, target_linux_server_id, branch, source_repo_root_path, source_workspace_root_path, status, attempt_count, next_retry_at, trace_id, created_at, updated_at ) values ( source.relocation_id, source.personal_workspace_id, source.app_workspace_version_id, source.user_id, source.runtime_workspace_id, source.source_linux_server_id, source.target_linux_server_id, source.branch, source.source_repo_root_path, source.source_workspace_root_path, 'DISCOVERED', 0, source.next_retry_at, source.trace_id, source.created_at, source.updated_at )
mapper.select: select from personal_workspace_relocations relocation where relocation.source_linux_server_id = #{sourceLinuxServerId} and ( (relocation.status in ('DISCOVERED', 'RETRY_WAIT') and relocation.next_retry_at <= #{now}) or (relocation.status in ('EXPORTING', 'TRANSFERRING', 'APPLYING') and (relocation.lease_until is null or relocation.lease_until <= #{now})) or (relocation.status = 'CLEANUP_PENDING' and relocation.next_retry_at <= #{now} and (relocation.lease_until is null or relocation.lease_until <= #{now})) ) and ( relocation.status = 'CLEANUP_PENDING' or exists ( select 1 from personal_workspaces current_personal join workspaces current_workspace on current_workspace.workspace_id = current_personal.runtime_workspace_id join user_opencode_process_bindings current_binding on current_binding.user_id = current_personal.user_id and current_binding.agent_id = 'opencode' and current_binding.status = 'ACTIVE' where current_personal.personal_workspace_id = relocation.personal_workspace_id and current_personal.status = 'ACTIVE' and current_personal.app_workspace_version_id = relocation.app_workspace_version_id and current_personal.user_id = relocation.user_id and current_personal.runtime_workspace_id = relocation.runtime_workspace_id and current_personal.branch = relocation.branch and current_personal.repo_root_path = relocation.source_repo_root_path and current_personal.workspace_root_path = relocation.source_workspace_root_path and current_workspace.status = 'ACTIVE' and current_workspace.linux_server_id = relocation.source_linux_server_id and current_binding.linux_server_id = relocation.target_linux_server_id and not exists ( select 1 from runs active_run where active_run.workspace_id = current_personal.runtime_workspace_id and active_run.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') ) ) ) order by relocation.updated_at, relocation.relocation_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update personal_workspace_relocations relocation set status = case when status = 'CLEANUP_PENDING' then status else 'EXPORTING' end, attempt_count = case when status = 'CLEANUP_PENDING' then attempt_count else attempt_count + 1 end, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = #{now}, safe_error_code = null, safe_error_message = null where relocation_id = #{relocationId} and ( (status in ('DISCOVERED', 'RETRY_WAIT') and next_retry_at <= #{now}) or (status in ('EXPORTING', 'TRANSFERRING', 'APPLYING') and (lease_until is null or lease_until <= #{now})) or (status = 'CLEANUP_PENDING' and next_retry_at <= #{now} and (lease_until is null or lease_until <= #{now})) ) and ( status = 'CLEANUP_PENDING' or exists ( select 1 from personal_workspaces current_personal join workspaces current_workspace on current_workspace.workspace_id = current_personal.runtime_workspace_id join user_opencode_process_bindings current_binding on current_binding.user_id = current_personal.user_id and current_binding.agent_id = 'opencode' and current_binding.status = 'ACTIVE' where current_personal.personal_workspace_id = relocation.personal_workspace_id and current_personal.status = 'ACTIVE' and current_personal.app_workspace_version_id = relocation.app_workspace_version_id and current_personal.user_id = relocation.user_id and current_personal.runtime_workspace_id = relocation.runtime_workspace_id and current_personal.branch = relocation.branch and current_personal.repo_root_path = relocation.source_repo_root_path and current_personal.workspace_root_path = relocation.source_workspace_root_path and current_workspace.status = 'ACTIVE' and current_workspace.linux_server_id = relocation.source_linux_server_id and current_binding.linux_server_id = relocation.target_linux_server_id and not exists ( select 1 from runs active_run where active_run.workspace_id = current_personal.runtime_workspace_id and active_run.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') ) ) )
mapper.select: select relocation.relocation_id from personal_workspace_relocations relocation join personal_workspaces personal on personal.personal_workspace_id = relocation.personal_workspace_id join workspaces runtime_workspace on runtime_workspace.workspace_id = relocation.runtime_workspace_id join user_opencode_process_bindings binding on binding.user_id = relocation.user_id and binding.agent_id = 'opencode' and binding.status = 'ACTIVE' where relocation.relocation_id = #{relocationId} and relocation.status = 'APPLYING' and relocation.source_linux_server_id = #{sourceLinuxServerId} and relocation.target_linux_server_id = #{targetLinuxServerId} and personal.status = 'ACTIVE' and personal.app_workspace_version_id = relocation.app_workspace_version_id and personal.user_id = relocation.user_id and personal.runtime_workspace_id = relocation.runtime_workspace_id and personal.branch = relocation.branch and personal.repo_root_path = relocation.source_repo_root_path and personal.workspace_root_path = relocation.source_workspace_root_path and runtime_workspace.status = 'ACTIVE' and runtime_workspace.linux_server_id = #{sourceLinuxServerId} and binding.linux_server_id = #{targetLinuxServerId} and not exists ( select 1 from runs active_run where active_run.workspace_id = relocation.runtime_workspace_id and active_run.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') ) for update
